name: finance-monitoring-system-demo
description: A demo web application for monitoring financial disbursements, tracking issued checks, and visualizing budget data (PS & MOOE).

paragraphs: A full-stack financial monitoring, auto-classification, and analytics web application designed for tracking fiscal disbursements, check issuances, and budget categorization for the Philippine Information Agency (PIA) Region 8 for Fiscal Year 2023.
features: 📊 Interactive Analytics Dashboard: Live KPIs, monthly disbursement trend SVG line chart, type distribution donut chart, top particulars, and top ORS values.

🤖 Smart Auto-Classification Engine: Context-aware categorization algorithm that automatically classifies disbursements into Personal Services (PS) or Maintenance & Other Operating Expenses (MOOE) using weighted keyword…
📁 Records Management & Multi-Column Sorting: Full tabular view with search by payee, ORS number, or particulars; filter by type and particulars; column sorting; and server-backed pagination.
➕ Add Entry Form: Instant record creation with auto-classification, live validation, and immediate dataset recalculation.

📥 Batch Excel / CSV Import: Drag-and-drop or select multi-sheet Excel workbooks. The parser automatically discovers header structures, extracts records, auto-classifies entries, checks for duplicates, and provides a…
